name: Crawl4AI
short_desc: LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper with a REST API
author: unclecode
description: Crawl4AI turns web pages into clean markdown for LLMs. It runs headless Chromium behind a REST API, supports deep crawling, CSS/XPath and LLM-based extraction, and exposes an MCP endpoint.

form_fields.label: API Token
form_fields.hint: Required. Without it the server binds loopback only and stays unreachable. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

form_fields.label: LLM Provider
form_fields.hint: LiteLLM-style model id used for LLM extraction, e.g. openai/qwen

form_fields.label: OpenAI-compatible Base URL
form_fields.hint: Point at your LiteLLM proxy, e.g. http://litellm:4000/v1

form_fields.label: LLM API Key
form_fields.hint: LiteLLM master key (or the provider's API key)

form_fields.label: Memory Limit
form_fields.hint: Hard cap for the container. Chromium needs ~400MB per open page.
